manual_audit.design: Fresh stratified adversarial review after completed genuine 100-question evaluation: two automated PASS variants and one automated failure were inspected from each of the six clinical families.
manual_audit.failure_gate_assessment: The sampled failures were appropriately fail-closed under the current evidence boundary; no gate relaxation is justified.

highest_leverage_defect.finding: Several packets still request or permit named clinical score content while the hardened launch compiler correctly rejects precomputed named-score assertions. Other repeated failures arise because packet context is less explicit than deterministic gates (e.g. varicella timing requires first-day reference; endometrial target requires complete HRT omission).
examples: ukmla-176 required CHA2DS2-VASc score while launch rules require raw components only
ukmla-4362 allowed a stated CURB-65 score while launch rules forbid precomputed totals
ukmla-4379 requested timing since exposure while deterministic validation requires an explicit first-day anchor
ukmla-4965 repeatedly mentioned HRT negatively despite a modifier-free target
ukmla-414 repeatedly inferred bleeding risk rather than stating a concrete explicit factor
highest_leverage_defect.repair: Align packet required-context language with the strict compiler, strengthen literal omission/reference-point rules, and add a generic option-uniqueness/state-consistency self-audit. No reviewer, safety, ambiguity, numerical, support, fallback-template or SBA gate is weakened.
